Description from the seller

Brand: Omega
Model: Constellation
Reference Number: 1561.61.00
Year of Production: circa 1998 (estimated dating based on serial 58.8xx.xxx).
Movement: High-precision Swiss quartz, Caliber Omega 1456 (as indicated on the pictogram card).
Case Material: Stainless steel. Fixed bezel engraved with black Roman numerals.
Case Diameter: 22.5 mm (standard size for the Mini version, excluding crown).
Bracelet Material: Original Omega integrated stainless steel link bracelet.
Crystal: Sapphire, scratch-resistant.
Included Accessories: Supplied with GENERIC box, and original warranty
Shipping: Fast, trackable and fully insured via DHL or FedEx.
